title_sq: Ne Laprake Prane Pallateve Te Arabit , Shitet Njesi Biznesi Me Planimetri Te Rregullt, Buze Rruges Kryesore!!
description_sq: Ne Laprake Prane Pallateve Te Arabit , Shitet Njesi Biznesi, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt, Buze Rruges Kryesore!!! Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 1 dhe 2 te nje pallati 12 katesh dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale 240 m2 nga te cilat 60 m2 kati i pare dhe 180 m2 kati i dyte. Organizohet nga 2 ambiente dhe 2 tualete. Njesia eshte me fasade xhami cka mundeson nje reklamim ideal per biznesin tuaj. Ndodhet ne nje objekt te pozicionuar ne Rrugen ''Dritan Hoxha'' dhe eshte nje nga zonat me te kerkuara ne Tirane per aktivitete te ndryshme tregtare. Prona posedon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Cmimi per kete prone eshte 54.000.000 Leke te reja. Ideale per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi si: market, pastrim kimik, furre buke, farmaci, klinike fizioterapie, klinike dentare dhe shume opsione te tjera biznesi.
title_en: In Laprake, near Palatate Te Arabi, a business unit for sale with a regular layout, on the side of the main street!!
description_en: In Laprak, near the Arab Palaces, a business unit for sale, with a regular layout, on the side of the main street!!! The environment is located on the 1st and 2nd floor of a 12-story building and has a total area of ​​240 m2, of which 60 m2 is the first floor and 180 m2 is the second floor. It is organized by 2 rooms and 2 toilets. The unit has a glass facade, which enables ideal advertising for your business. It is located in a building located on "Dritan Hoxha" Street and is one of the most sought-after areas in Tirana for various commercial activities. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The price for this property is 54,000,000 new Lek. Ideal for different types of business such as: market, dry cleaning, bakery, pharmacy, physiotherapy clinic, dental clinic and many other business options.
